_comment: Literal-credential cases evaluated by BOTH refusals: capsule.literal_credentials
tests/test_credential_parity.py applies each case's patch to `base`; `expect` is what
both must decide, and `chart_differs` records a deliberate difference with its reason.
The literal values here are made up and credential-shaped on purpose.

chart_differs.reason: The chart holds EVERY header to the reference rule unless allowLiteralHeaders lists it: a ConfigMap is readable by anyone who can read ConfigMaps, and a header name is not proof of what it carries. A capsule has no allow-list, and a literal X-Tenant-Id is part of a proof.
